name: Powers-of-ten pull-back
look: The stage opens on the product's own interface filling the whole screen. The camera pulls back at a steady rate (the scale eased in log space, so it never seems to stop) until the interface is the screen of a device standing on the page's lit ground; the device settles into its slot at the right and the heading, copy and action arrive at the left. A product section under the hero, never the hero itself: its first screen carries no heading and no action.
reduced: The composition: copy at the left, the device on its ground at the right.
phone: The finished composition: the copy over the device, a 4:5 crop of the screen.

needs.ui: the product's interface at its true size: a screenshot (16:10) or an HTML fragment. The scene ships the device, its ground and its copy (scene.css); the screen inside is the page's own and the page links its CSS (a ui fragment: assets/ui/base.css and its fragment.css). The .ux window in demo.html is drawn by _demo/demo.css, which is for the demo pages only: never copy it to a page
needs.words: a label, a heading, one line and one action

never: as the page's hero (the first screen would open with no headline and no action); a stock photograph of a room as the place; a drawn device with a notch, a keyboard or a stand (a thin bezel is enough); two devices
